growth.meaning_en: the process of increasing in size or development
growth.example: The company experienced rapid growth last year.

behavior.meaning_en: the way in which one acts or conducts oneself
behavior.example: His behavior at the meeting was professional.

routine.meaning_en: a sequence of actions regularly followed
routine.example: She established a morning routine to start her day.

trigger.meaning_en: to cause an event or situation to happen
trigger.example: The smell of coffee can trigger memories of breakfast.
